 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Cody Rhodes is paying tribute to his late dog Pharaoh through his latest WWE merchandise. WWE Shop has released a new T-shirt featuring the Siberian Husky, and Cody had a short but touching reaction when he shared the announcement on X.
 The shirt features Pharaoh's face in a new logo, while the other side has a husky-inspired version of Cody's American Nightmare design. It keeps the familiar wings and red, white, and blue colors but replaces the traditional skull with an image inspired by his dog.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement WWE Shop announced the release by mentioning how Pharaoh had become a familiar face to wrestling fans through his appearances with Cody over the years.
 "Every American Nightmare needs a loyal companion. Cody Rhodes' Siberian Husky, Pharaoh, won fans over backstage and on the ramp—and now he's featured on Cody's latest tee," the post read.
 Cody shared the announcement himself, writing, "Lil' logo change, the best boy 🐾"
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The design was something he had spoken about before its release. During an October appearance on the " Flagrant " podcast, Cody revealed that he wanted to give the American Nightmare logo a new look following Pharaoh's death.
 "I'm about to change—not change the logo because we can't change the tattoo—but for the first time ever, the way the American Nightmare, exactly this logo which is on everything we do, I'm going to—it's going to be a wolf skull that's turned with the wings out to the side," he explained.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Cody also shared why he wanted to make the change, revealing that the idea came after losing Pharaoh following nearly 16 years together. The new merchandise has now turned that plan into reality, with the dog becoming part of one of Cody's most recognizable designs.
 Cody Rhodes Shared an Emotional Tribute After Pharaoh's Death
 Cody Rhodes in deafeat during WWE Elimination Chamber(Photo by Craig Melvin/WWE via Getty Images)
 Cody announced Pharaoh's passing on September 8, 2026. The Siberian Husky had been with the Rhodes family for almost 16 years and was often seen accompanying Cody at wrestling events during his time in both WWE and AEW.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In his farewell message, Rhodes spoke about how Pharaoh stayed by his side through difficult periods in his life . He also remembered the connection the dog developed with his daughter, Liberty, after she was born.
 Cody explained that huskies need a job, and he felt Pharaoh finally found his when he began looking after Liberty.
 "That is until Liberty was born," he wrote while recalling how the dog watched over his daughter.
 He ended his message with a few words that summed up what Pharaoh meant to the family: "You did your job. We love you."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Pharaoh was already a familiar name among wrestling fans, but the new T-shirt gives his memory a place in Cody's merchandise for years to come. It is also a reminder of the companion who stayed with him for nearly 16 years.
